practice_quiz.question: Assessment Question 1: Which statement correctly evaluates Solving Linear Equations (Unit 9)?
practice_quiz.question_amharic: የምዘና ጥያቄ 1፡ ስለ ሊኒያር እኩልዮሽ (Linear Equation) መፍትሔ (ምዕራፍ 9) ትክክለኛውን መግለጫ የትኛው ነው?
options: Solving Linear Equations is a core topic in Grade 9 Mathematics covering essential principles on pages 322-375.
